_how_to_edit: Home page photos. carousel = the slideshow under 'A global network of alumni' (first card is the opener; 4–6 cards). pillars = the three 'What we do' cards. Put new photos in assets/img/ (any size; ~2000px wide is plenty), reference them here, write the caption as what the photo actually shows, then run `python3 build.py`. 'position' is CSS object-position — which part of the photo stays in frame when it is cropped (e.g. '50% 30%' keeps faces in the upper third).
